result.commit: feat(storefront): add PLP Quick View modal with trigger, context provider, and add-to-cart flow

contract_testids_implemented.quick-view-add-to-cart-btn: modal-body.jsx - custom Button with disabled state forwarding
contract_testids_implemented.quick-view-trigger-{productId}: trigger.jsx - one per eligible tile (25 on dresses PLP)

key_decisions: Renders own Add-to-Cart button (not delegating to ProductView) to own the testid and disabled state
Uses useDerivedProduct + controlledVariationValues for external variation tracking
Trigger uses isMounted pattern for SSR safety
Modal gated on {isOpen && ...} so no product detail fetches during SSR
Set/bundle products excluded via trigger null-return (FR-014)
No second AddToCartModal mounted - uses useAddToCartModalContext().onOpen
result.summary: Implemented PLP Product Quick View Modal feature for the commerce storefront
